name: print-social-50th-birthday-posts-with-blue-blobs-and-halftone-dots
title: 50th birthday pack with a silver-haired model, blue blobs, sparkles and halftone dots
whatItIs: Nine white square posts for a 50th birthday: a silver-haired woman in pale blue, blue gradient blobs behind her, coral starburst badges with dates, black sparkle stars, halftone dot fields and serif headlines ('Fifty & Fabulous', 'Vintage Celebrate').
whatItMeans: Soft serifs and sparkles feel celebratory yet elegant, pitching a milestone birthday as glamorous rather than old.
techniques: Put a soft colour blob behind the cut-out subject.
Stamp key details on a starburst badge.
Use halftone dots as a light retro texture.
Scatter four-point sparkles as festive punctuation.

vocabulary.definition: A spiky seal-shaped label for dates or offers.
A pattern of dots that simulates tone.
